title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: One runnable Spanish-language staff ERP demo for fictional Clínica Dental Andina. Same responsive shell with direct physicians, specialties, rooms, laboratory, imaging, disease/allergy reference catalogs and initial Triage menus. Patient-scoped explicitly saved habits and antecedents feed read-only Triage; clinical fields/protocol remain undefined, with no scoring or recommendations. Existing appointment, consultation, study, one-order, simulated cash/non-payable QR and DEMO receipt workflows retained. Stable-ID in-memory records, integer-cent billing and immutable issued lines; reload resets everything. S1-S11 prototype scope covered, never real clinical/payment/backend readiness. Offline public-UI smoke: PASS 406 checks; zero HTTP/API/storage writes or page errors.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Direct resource/reference menus, saved patient habits and initial read-only Triage alongside the preserved catalog-to-consultation-to-receipt demo; no clinical protocol, scoring, real medicine, payment provider or durable storage
